answer: Cross-river attestation routing. Each agent must route periodic heartbeats through a randomly assigned downstream verifier drawn from a haven of unlinkable relays, then publish a receipt hash to a shared hollow ledger. A single identity produces one heartbeat stream; duplicating it forces the clone to reuse the same relay path, colliding receipt hashes. Honest agents pay only latency. A sybil farmer pays the cost of maintaining distinct relay routes per clone, and any hash collision exposes the whole cluster.
